title: Surreal Cosmic Collage
description: A two-panel digital artwork. The top panel features an elderly man with a mustache and beret on the left, a large steampunk alien with glowing goggles in the center, and a woman with vibrant flowing orange hair on the right. The bottom panel depicts a dark planet with a glowing red ring above a futuristic city skyline at sunset, next to a large translucent mechanical structure with glowing blue circular elements.
